lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly five parallel horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a defined grid-like lattice across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with high-intensity specular highlights on the dorsal edge and distinct shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of high-luminance circular blobs strictly contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the basal and posterior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-luminance spot patterning on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin and a high-density cluster of smaller spots on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits.
